scope: Bounded owned GLSurface worker cleanup and actual return-code/timestamp diagnostics; no fake quiescence.

motivation.interpretation: The previous2s total worker wait expired while termination had not returned. No proof yet that eglTerminate itself failed or that6s fixes the actual device/emulator run.
motivation.observed: Actual portrait fixture reports720x1280 callbacks matching surface dimensions,30frames and native readback mask15. Return failed at owned worker join with no eglTerminate completion event.

policy.watchdog_origin: Watchdog is started after the stop marker is written and before Rust lifecycle callbacks;15s runs from its wait entry.
policy.ownership: Actual successful thread wait and close are required. Timeout and sticky EGL close failure retain owners, reject renderer reuse, and require process exit.
policy.diagnostics: Per-launch fresh logs/media-stop.log includes raw wait/thread/close outcomes, EGL begin/end ticks/results, and quiesce outcomes. Missing completion remains incomplete evidence.

host_check.regression: portrait-slow-termination uses a real host worker with2.2s fake EGL teardown and checks successful6s wait, TLS cleanup and detach. Existing forced-timeout scenario verifies raw wait error is retained and reuse blocked.

emulator_fix_verification: Pending separate parent-owned actual NRO rerun; no emulator launched by this subtask.
